shorts.title: What you will learn: Class templates
shorts.hook: Build your own container for any type.
shorts.script: Build your own container for any type. Today we build a container. With a class template, the same class can hold ints, doubles or strings. A class template puts a type placeholder on the whole class. When you make an object, you name the type in angle brackets. The compiler then builds a class for that type. The standard library containers, such as vector, are class templates. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: What you will learn: Class templates.

shorts.title: Class templates in one minute
shorts.hook: A class template puts a type placeholder on the whole class.
shorts.script: A class template puts a type placeholder on the whole class. When you make an object, you name the type in angle brackets. The compiler then builds a class for that type. The standard library containers, such as vector, are class templates. Think of a storage box with a blank label. You write int, double or string on it when you use it. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Class templates in one minute.

shorts.title: Inside the second program
shorts.hook: Inside, a vector of T holds the items.
shorts.script: Inside, a vector of T holds the items. Push adds an item at the end. Pop removes the last item, and returns it. Here we make a stack of ints. We push one, two and three. Pop gives the last item first. The output is three, two, one. The program prints three, two and one. A class template has a type placeholder. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Inside the second program.

shorts.title: Bug of the Day: A missing template argument
shorts.hook: Can you spot the bug in class templates?
shorts.script: Can you spot the bug in class templates? Bug of the Day. We make a Box with no type. The compiler says class template argument deduction failed. It has nothing to learn T from. Write the type in angle brackets, as in Box of int. The compiler cannot guess T when there is no constructor argument to learn it from. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
shorts.caption: Bug of the Day: A missing template argument.

shorts.title: Pun and challenge
shorts.hook: Can you make a Pair template in class templates?
shorts.script: Can you make a Pair template in class templates? My template is an open-minded class. It accepts any type, but it still wants a label. Write a class template Pair with two members of the same type T. Add a function that returns the bigger one. Write your answer in the comments. A class template has a type placeholder. Keep coding, says Xecxec!
